name: openapi-codegen-sandbox
description: Isolated install for the OpenAPI client generator. @hey-api/openapi-ts needs the TypeScript 5 JS compiler API (ts.SyntaxKind…), which the project's typescript@7 (native tsgo) no longer ships — so the generator and a pinned TS 5 live here, resolved before the project's node_modules. Run it via `make api-client` or `bun run api:generate` from apps/next.
